gen.title: Computing apportionment by equal proportions
gen.orderNote: Follow page order from automatic seats to final tally

steps.label: Each state receives its automatic seat
steps.quote: Each of the 50 states is given one seat out of the current total of 435.

steps.label: Determine multiplier with geometric mean formula
steps.quote: 1 divided by the square root of n(n-1)

steps.label: Calculate priority values from population totals
steps.quote: The resulting numbers are the priority values.

steps.label: Rank priority values and assign remaining seats
steps.quote: the next step is to rank and assign seat numbers to the resulting priority values starting with seat 51, until all 435 seats have been assigned

steps.label: Tally final seat totals for each state
steps.quote: Next, tally the number of seats for each state to arrive at the total number of seats in the House of Representatives apportioned to each state.
